name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 4
source:
The heroine Ashihara Chihiro is a normal high school girl until one day a mysterious man informed her that she is a princess from Toyoashira. Following this alarming piece of news, a battle with a monster ensues where she discovers her powers as well as that of her teacher and best friend.

More discoveries about her past and her fallen country are made when she wakes up in the world she fled from when she was a child. After battles against monsters she realized her role in this calamity as "Ryuujin no Miko" and that to revive her country, she has to go to war with the enemy nation that has invaded hers in the first place.

During her adventures, she met up with a number of charismatic men, starting with her teacher and her best friend. But as a princess, falling for these men is prohibited. Together with the troubles that romance brings, Chihiro has to face the final battle with her bow and arrow as her only true ally.

translation:
女主角苇原千寻原本只是一名普通女高中生，直到有一天，一名神秘男子告诉她，她其实是丰苇原的公主。这个惊人消息传来后，一场与怪物的战斗随即爆发，她也由此发现了自己、老师和挚友各自拥有的力量。

当她在幼年逃离的世界中醒来后，逐渐得知更多有关自身过去和亡国的真相。经历一场场与怪物的战斗，她意识到自己在这场灾难中肩负着“龙神神子”的使命；为了复兴祖国，她必须与最初侵略故国的敌对国家开战。

冒险途中，她遇见了许多富有魅力的男子，最先陪伴她的便是老师和挚友。然而身为公主，她不被允许爱上这些人。除了恋情带来的烦恼，千寻还必须迎接最终决战，而弓箭将是她唯一真正的依靠。
